QUESTION PQ-62 (planned halt: survey). Read-only, at 1fbc6bd. I ran the unchanged rule (same RATIO, kind words and distribution_hits) over every UTF-8 file outside bank/, skipping target/, node_modules/, .git/ and .venv/. It scanned 362 files and found 63 hit lines in 11 files. docs/RUNBOOK.md, web/README.md, popquiz/src/copy.rs, the five page shells, SPEC.md and EVALUATION.md are all clean.

Hits, file (count): lines. Full text: $TMPDIR/pq62-survey.txt in the PQ-62 panel; it is also attached to PQ-62 as "Survey".
1. PRD.md (8): 346, 347, 351, 352, 353, 773, 774, 974. The superseded 79.99% / 0.01% / 20% category weights, a real tell in a public file.
2. sequence/research/00-synthesis.md (2): 42, 75. sequence/research/01-problem-and-people.md (4): 80, 83, 84, 324. sequence/research/03-economics.md (1): 68. sequence/research/04-generation-verification.md (21): 29, 89, 150, 151, 152, 161, 162, 261, 389, 395, 396, 397, 406, 408, 409, 418, 547, 578, 581, 589, 590. sequence/run-state.md (4): 160, 182, 347, 1862. These quote or analyse the PRD weights, plus some false positives such as Miri timing and "8/10" scores.
3. docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md (1): 483. It quotes the M11a mutation sentence.
4. pipeline/tests/test_audit.py (12): 474-479, 487, 494, 496, 508, 588, 791. These are the lint's own test inputs.
5. mvp/2026-08-12/pop-quiz-2026-08-12.html (8): 163, 200, 220, 244, 245, 277, 313, 333. mvp/2026-08-12/pop-quiz-2026-08-12-q3.html (1): 140. All false positives: "5 of 5 native runs produced byte-identical output" in the receipts, and "-7 / 2" in one explanation. These are the retired deck's build output.
6. BUILDPLAN.md (1): 56. A false positive: "batch's 50% discount", with "structured outputs" on the next line.

I cannot edit any of these files: every one is outside my cleared files or on the never-edit list. So "fix" means a follow-up outside PQ-62, and the file stays a hit (red) until it is fixed or exempted.

Question for Michelle. Which of these may carry tells and join the exemption list? Which must be fixed instead? My recommendation:
- Exempt by path, each with a one-line reason: sequence/ (directory), docs/audit/ (directory), pipeline/tests/test_audit.py, and mvp/2026-08-12/ (directory).
- Exempt BUILDPLAN.md:56 by exact line, as the mvp/README.md line is today. The rest of BUILDPLAN stays checked.
- PRD.md: your call. It is the only hit that states a category prior outright. Exempting it ships a public tell. Fixing it needs a separate change, since PRD.md is never-edit for me. I recommend exempting PRD.md by path for this ticket and recording the fix as not-done in DONE.
- My own call, unless you object: I will also skip Python caches (__pycache__/, .pytest_cache/, .ruff_cache/, .mypy_cache/) as build output. None of them hit today.

Reply RESUME PQ-62 with your rulings, as a Lattice comment or in this panel.

Proposed fix, about 10 lines in audit.py plus 2 tests, each shown failing first: strip NUL characters from the text before matching (that recovers the text of BOM-less UTF-16/32), and pass os.walk an onerror that adds the directory to unreadable. Options: D (recommended) apply both, run just test, push to PR #125 and return to review with no fourth pass, saying so in the PR body. E leave PR #125 as is with both gaps listed as known. F apply both, then a fourth Codex pass. Reply RESUME PQ-62 D, E or F.
